'''Zhailaut''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] that lived in the village of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and loosely associated with a [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|Wookiee resistance group]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Zhailaut sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gursan Bryes]] to kill the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Cyssc Blackscale]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zhailaut appeared as a non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online-[[roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
